# Perfora

> Perfora is a clinically proven oral care brand offering teeth whitening, electric toothbrushes, toothpastes, and comprehensive dental hygiene solutions for everyday care.

Founded by Tushar and Jatan, Perfora has gained recognition through media appearances including Shark Tank India. The brand specializes in innovative oral care products including self-dissolving whitening strips, sonic electric toothbrushes, SLS-free toothpastes, and probiotic mouthwashes, with dedicated product lines for sensitivity relief, fresh breath, plaque removal, and kids' dental care.
